issues.on_page: Support services - Staff 4,739,240 (p7); Statement of Activities p4 shows Support services - Instructional 3,739,240
issues.issue: [fixed] A transfer is counted as spending. The government-wide Statement of Activities (p4) reports this function as exactly 1,000,000 lower than the fund statement and the GF schedule (p14 Total support services - instructional 4,739,240, which includes 2230 Technology 1,000,006). The Depreciation Fund (p10, p22) shows a 1,000,000 'Transfer from general fund' that has no matching outflow in the General Fund's other financing (p16 shows only 75,000). The hidden-transfer rule applies: split into 3,739,240 spending plus a 1,000,000 transfer out, both with split_from (p14/p4) and review.

issues.on_page: GF Transfers in (out) (75,000) plus the 1,000,000 hidden in GF support services - instructional (p4 vs p7/p14)
issues.issue: [fixed] Should be 1,075,000 (computed: 75,000 printed + 1,000,000 reclassified from GF support services spending), which matches transfers_in 1,075,000. The identity still holds after the change because disbursements drop by the same 1,000,000.

issues.on_page: GF Support services - instructional group (total 4,739,240) contains the 1,000,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund; the transfer is not in GF other financing
issues.issue: [fixed] detail lacks a contra expenditure line (-1,000,000, department 'Support services - instructional', split_from naming the group's lines on p14 and the p4 elimination, review) and a GF 'other financing' line of -1,000,000 (transfer to Depreciation Fund). issues.on_page: Other 951,926 = GF 87,846 (rental 19,269 + other local 68,577) + Special Building 594,826 (other local 175,000 + 3599 other state categorical programs 419,826) + Nonmajor 269,254 (Activities other local 181,942 + Cooperative receipts 87,312)
issues.issue: [fixed] The extractor's own breakdown puts 507,138 of this line (53%) under intergovernmental/state aid (419,826 state categorical, plus 87,312 Cooperative, which detail[160] codes as intergovernmental). The rule says a category above half sets the category, so this should be intergovernmental/state aid with review naming the mix. Note that without the Cooperative receipts the state share is 44%, so the fix depends on how the Cooperative receipts are classified.

The statement label says pro-rate, which the rules treat as state aid. But the GF schedule (p11, 1125 Motor vehicle taxes) and the Statement of Activities (p5 Taxes - Motor vehicle 8,378,243, with pro-rate shown separately at 192,739) both show it is motor vehicle tax. The category is defensible; the label is the report's mislabel. Already marked review.

issues.on_page: Fund balances - ending 109,566,695; governmental cash and cash equivalents 110,453,097 (p6, p3)
issues.issue: beginning_cash and ending_cash are the modified-cash fund balances (they include inventories 252,570 and are net of payroll liabilities), not cash. The governmental cash figure is 110,453,097. The same applies to business_type: its measure is 'cash', but beginning and ending are net position (cash 11,312,046 less payroll liabilities 1,105). Defensible because these are the balances the statement rolls forward.
